# Power Without War: stockpiles, per-resource effects (see pww_stock_core.txt
# for the model, constants and the public interface).
#
#   pww_stock_tick_<res>    (country) accrue + decay since the last tick, read
#                           the stable balance, set this period's fill or draw
#                           rate. Needs temps pww_stk_el (days since the last
#                           tick) and pww_stk_e (export share, modifier
#                           min_export) from pww_stock_country_tick.
#   pww_stock_cap_<res>     (country) capacity, fill %, days of use covered.
#   pww_stock_value_<res>   (country) temp out pww_stock_unit_value: what one
#                           unit a day of <res> put in THIS country's reserve
#                           is worth, in civilian factories.
#   pww_stock_seize_<res>   (capitulated country, FROM = occupier) moves the
#                           seized share to FROM.
###############################################################################

### aluminium

pww_stock_tick_aluminium = {
	# Accrue the rates in force since the last tick.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_in_aluminium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_out_aluminium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	add_to_variable = { pww_stock_aluminium = pww_stk_d }
	# Decay: global.pww_stock_c_decay of the stock per 30 days.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_aluminium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = global.pww_stock_c_decay }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = 30 }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_aluminium = pww_stk_d }
	clamp_variable = { var = pww_stock_aluminium min = 0 max = 1000000 }

	# Stable balance B: what resource@ would read without our own flows.
	#   cost = the part of the intake applied as country_resource_cost (cartel
	#          withholding, or all of it when c_fill_cost = 1)
	#   leak = clamp(exported - (produced - out) x share, 0, out x share)
	#          (part of a draw re-exported under the trade law)
	#   B    = resource@ + cost - out + leak
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = resource_produced@aluminium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = pww_stock_out_aluminium }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_p }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_e }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = resource_exported@aluminium }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_out_aluminium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stk_e }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_lk > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_m } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_lk min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = resource@aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_cost_aluminium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_out_aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stk_lk }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_bal_aluminium = pww_stk_b }

	pww_stock_cap_aluminium = yes

	set_variable = { pww_stock_in_aluminium = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_aluminium = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_out_aluminium = 0 }
	if = {
		# Fill: a share of the unsold leftover, within capacity and the daily
		# rate. By default (c_fill_cost = 0) it is stored WITHOUT a cost
		# modifier: the leftover is unused output, and a resource cost would
		# shrink the export pool (production x min_export), which the AI
		# buys out almost everywhere, so it would cut exports.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_aluminium < pww_stock_cap_aluminium }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = global.pww_stock_c_fill_share }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_aluminium }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_aluminium }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_aluminium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_fill_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = global.pww_stock_c_fill_cost }
		# A cartel quota (pww_cartel_store_<res>, units a day) may ask storage
		# to take more: the extra is withheld through the cost modifier
		# (cutting exports is the quota's purpose), within B and capacity.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cartel_store_aluminium > pww_stk_f } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_cartel_store_aluminium }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_b } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_b } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_aluminium }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_aluminium }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_m } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_f } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_g }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_g }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_in_aluminium = pww_stk_f }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_aluminium = pww_stk_cst }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		# Draw: cover the shortfall, capped by throughput (a share of
		# capacity a day) and by what lasts until the next tick.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b < global.pww_stock_c_min_flow_neg }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_aluminium > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_aluminium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_draw_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_aluminium }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_out_aluminium = pww_stk_f }
		}
	}
}

pww_stock_cap_aluminium = {
	# Demand = met use + shortfall (resource_consumed is met use only: it
	# reads 0 for a country that has none of the resource).
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource_consumed@aluminium }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { resource@aluminium < 0 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource@aluminium }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_use }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_sc < global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_base_days }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = pww_stock_depots }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = global.pww_stock_c_depot_mult }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_lv }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cap_aluminium = pww_stk_sc }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = pww_stock_aluminium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl value = pww_stock_cap_aluminium if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_fill_aluminium = pww_stk_fl }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_use < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stock_aluminium }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stk_use }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_dy min = 0 max = 9999 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_days_aluminium = pww_stk_dy }
}

pww_stock_value_aluminium = {
	pww_stock_tension_factor = yes
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stock_fill_aluminium }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 100 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stv_g }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 1 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stv_g min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = global.pww_stock_c_market }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_t }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_g }
}

pww_stock_seize_aluminium = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = pww_stock_aluminium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = global.pww_stock_c_seize }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_aluminium = pww_stk_s }
	pww_stock_cap_aluminium = yes
	FROM = {
		add_to_variable = { pww_stock_aluminium = pww_stk_s }
		pww_stock_cap_aluminium = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stock_aluminium > pww_stock_cap_aluminium } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_aluminium = pww_stock_cap_aluminium }
			pww_stock_cap_aluminium = yes
		}
	}
}

pww_stock_tick_rubber = {
	# Accrue the rates in force since the last tick.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_in_rubber }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_out_rubber }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	add_to_variable = { pww_stock_rubber = pww_stk_d }
	# Decay: global.pww_stock_c_decay of the stock per 30 days.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_rubber }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = global.pww_stock_c_decay }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = 30 }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_rubber = pww_stk_d }
	clamp_variable = { var = pww_stock_rubber min = 0 max = 1000000 }

	# Stable balance B: what resource@ would read without our own flows.
	#   cost = the part of the intake applied as country_resource_cost (cartel
	#          withholding, or all of it when c_fill_cost = 1)
	#   leak = clamp(exported - (produced - out) x share, 0, out x share)
	#          (part of a draw re-exported under the trade law)
	#   B    = resource@ + cost - out + leak
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = resource_produced@rubber }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = pww_stock_out_rubber }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_p }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_e }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = resource_exported@rubber }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_out_rubber }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stk_e }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_lk > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_m } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_lk min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = resource@rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_cost_rubber }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_out_rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stk_lk }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_bal_rubber = pww_stk_b }

	pww_stock_cap_rubber = yes

	set_variable = { pww_stock_in_rubber = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_rubber = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_out_rubber = 0 }
	if = {
		# Fill: a share of the unsold leftover, within capacity and the daily
		# rate. By default (c_fill_cost = 0) it is stored WITHOUT a cost
		# modifier: the leftover is unused output, and a resource cost would
		# shrink the export pool (production x min_export), which the AI
		# buys out almost everywhere, so it would cut exports.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_rubber < pww_stock_cap_rubber }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = global.pww_stock_c_fill_share }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_rubber }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_rubber }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_rubber }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_fill_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = global.pww_stock_c_fill_cost }
		# A cartel quota (pww_cartel_store_<res>, units a day) may ask storage
		# to take more: the extra is withheld through the cost modifier
		# (cutting exports is the quota's purpose), within B and capacity.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cartel_store_rubber > pww_stk_f } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_cartel_store_rubber }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_b } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_b } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_rubber }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_rubber }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_m } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_f } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_g }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_g }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_in_rubber = pww_stk_f }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_rubber = pww_stk_cst }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		# Draw: cover the shortfall, capped by throughput (a share of
		# capacity a day) and by what lasts until the next tick.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b < global.pww_stock_c_min_flow_neg }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_rubber > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_rubber }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_draw_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_rubber }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_out_rubber = pww_stk_f }
		}
	}
}

pww_stock_cap_rubber = {
	# Demand = met use + shortfall (resource_consumed is met use only: it
	# reads 0 for a country that has none of the resource).
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource_consumed@rubber }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { resource@rubber < 0 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource@rubber }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_use }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_sc < global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_base_days }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = pww_stock_depots }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = global.pww_stock_c_depot_mult }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_lv }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cap_rubber = pww_stk_sc }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = pww_stock_rubber }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl value = pww_stock_cap_rubber if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_fill_rubber = pww_stk_fl }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_use < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stock_rubber }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stk_use }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_dy min = 0 max = 9999 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_days_rubber = pww_stk_dy }
}

pww_stock_value_rubber = {
	pww_stock_tension_factor = yes
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stock_fill_rubber }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 100 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stv_g }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 1 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stv_g min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = global.pww_stock_c_market }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_t }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_g }
}

pww_stock_seize_rubber = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = pww_stock_rubber }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = global.pww_stock_c_seize }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_rubber = pww_stk_s }
	pww_stock_cap_rubber = yes
	FROM = {
		add_to_variable = { pww_stock_rubber = pww_stk_s }
		pww_stock_cap_rubber = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stock_rubber > pww_stock_cap_rubber } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_rubber = pww_stock_cap_rubber }
			pww_stock_cap_rubber = yes
		}
	}
}

pww_stock_tick_tungsten = {
	# Accrue the rates in force since the last tick.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_in_tungsten }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_out_tungsten }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	add_to_variable = { pww_stock_tungsten = pww_stk_d }
	# Decay: global.pww_stock_c_decay of the stock per 30 days.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_tungsten }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = global.pww_stock_c_decay }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = 30 }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_tungsten = pww_stk_d }
	clamp_variable = { var = pww_stock_tungsten min = 0 max = 1000000 }

	# Stable balance B: what resource@ would read without our own flows.
	#   cost = the part of the intake applied as country_resource_cost (cartel
	#          withholding, or all of it when c_fill_cost = 1)
	#   leak = clamp(exported - (produced - out) x share, 0, out x share)
	#          (part of a draw re-exported under the trade law)
	#   B    = resource@ + cost - out + leak
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = resource_produced@tungsten }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = pww_stock_out_tungsten }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_p }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_e }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = resource_exported@tungsten }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_out_tungsten }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stk_e }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_lk > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_m } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_lk min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = resource@tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_cost_tungsten }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_out_tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stk_lk }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_bal_tungsten = pww_stk_b }

	pww_stock_cap_tungsten = yes

	set_variable = { pww_stock_in_tungsten = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_tungsten = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_out_tungsten = 0 }
	if = {
		# Fill: a share of the unsold leftover, within capacity and the daily
		# rate. By default (c_fill_cost = 0) it is stored WITHOUT a cost
		# modifier: the leftover is unused output, and a resource cost would
		# shrink the export pool (production x min_export), which the AI
		# buys out almost everywhere, so it would cut exports.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_tungsten < pww_stock_cap_tungsten }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = global.pww_stock_c_fill_share }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_tungsten }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_tungsten }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_tungsten }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_fill_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = global.pww_stock_c_fill_cost }
		# A cartel quota (pww_cartel_store_<res>, units a day) may ask storage
		# to take more: the extra is withheld through the cost modifier
		# (cutting exports is the quota's purpose), within B and capacity.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cartel_store_tungsten > pww_stk_f } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_cartel_store_tungsten }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_b } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_b } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_tungsten }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_tungsten }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_m } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_f } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_g }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_g }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_in_tungsten = pww_stk_f }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_tungsten = pww_stk_cst }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		# Draw: cover the shortfall, capped by throughput (a share of
		# capacity a day) and by what lasts until the next tick.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b < global.pww_stock_c_min_flow_neg }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_tungsten > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_tungsten }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_draw_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_tungsten }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_out_tungsten = pww_stk_f }
		}
	}
}

pww_stock_cap_tungsten = {
	# Demand = met use + shortfall (resource_consumed is met use only: it
	# reads 0 for a country that has none of the resource).
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource_consumed@tungsten }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { resource@tungsten < 0 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource@tungsten }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_use }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_sc < global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_base_days }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = pww_stock_depots }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = global.pww_stock_c_depot_mult }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_lv }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cap_tungsten = pww_stk_sc }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = pww_stock_tungsten }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl value = pww_stock_cap_tungsten if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_fill_tungsten = pww_stk_fl }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_use < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stock_tungsten }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stk_use }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_dy min = 0 max = 9999 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_days_tungsten = pww_stk_dy }
}

pww_stock_value_tungsten = {
	pww_stock_tension_factor = yes
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stock_fill_tungsten }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 100 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stv_g }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 1 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stv_g min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = global.pww_stock_c_market }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_t }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_g }
}

pww_stock_seize_tungsten = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = pww_stock_tungsten }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = global.pww_stock_c_seize }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_tungsten = pww_stk_s }
	pww_stock_cap_tungsten = yes
	FROM = {
		add_to_variable = { pww_stock_tungsten = pww_stk_s }
		pww_stock_cap_tungsten = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stock_tungsten > pww_stock_cap_tungsten } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_tungsten = pww_stock_cap_tungsten }
			pww_stock_cap_tungsten = yes
		}
	}
}

### steel

pww_stock_tick_steel = {
	# Accrue the rates in force since the last tick.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_in_steel }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_out_steel }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	add_to_variable = { pww_stock_steel = pww_stk_d }
	# Decay: global.pww_stock_c_decay of the stock per 30 days.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_steel }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = global.pww_stock_c_decay }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = 30 }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_steel = pww_stk_d }
	clamp_variable = { var = pww_stock_steel min = 0 max = 1000000 }

	# Stable balance B: what resource@ would read without our own flows.
	#   cost = the part of the intake applied as country_resource_cost (cartel
	#          withholding, or all of it when c_fill_cost = 1)
	#   leak = clamp(exported - (produced - out) x share, 0, out x share)
	#          (part of a draw re-exported under the trade law)
	#   B    = resource@ + cost - out + leak
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = resource_produced@steel }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = pww_stock_out_steel }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_p }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_e }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = resource_exported@steel }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_out_steel }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stk_e }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_lk > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_m } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_lk min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = resource@steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_cost_steel }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_out_steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stk_lk }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_bal_steel = pww_stk_b }

	pww_stock_cap_steel = yes

	set_variable = { pww_stock_in_steel = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_steel = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_out_steel = 0 }
	if = {
		# Fill: a share of the unsold leftover, within capacity and the daily
		# rate. By default (c_fill_cost = 0) it is stored WITHOUT a cost
		# modifier: the leftover is unused output, and a resource cost would
		# shrink the export pool (production x min_export), which the AI
		# buys out almost everywhere, so it would cut exports.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_steel < pww_stock_cap_steel }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = global.pww_stock_c_fill_share }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_steel }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_steel }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_steel }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_fill_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = global.pww_stock_c_fill_cost }
		# A cartel quota (pww_cartel_store_<res>, units a day) may ask storage
		# to take more: the extra is withheld through the cost modifier
		# (cutting exports is the quota's purpose), within B and capacity.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cartel_store_steel > pww_stk_f } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_cartel_store_steel }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_b } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_b } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_steel }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_steel }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_m } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_f } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_g }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_g }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_in_steel = pww_stk_f }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_steel = pww_stk_cst }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		# Draw: cover the shortfall, capped by throughput (a share of
		# capacity a day) and by what lasts until the next tick.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b < global.pww_stock_c_min_flow_neg }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_steel > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_steel }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_draw_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_steel }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_out_steel = pww_stk_f }
		}
	}
}

pww_stock_cap_steel = {
	# Demand = met use + shortfall (resource_consumed is met use only: it
	# reads 0 for a country that has none of the resource).
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource_consumed@steel }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { resource@steel < 0 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource@steel }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_use }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_sc < global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_base_days }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = pww_stock_depots }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = global.pww_stock_c_depot_mult }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_lv }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cap_steel = pww_stk_sc }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = pww_stock_steel }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl value = pww_stock_cap_steel if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_fill_steel = pww_stk_fl }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_use < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stock_steel }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stk_use }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_dy min = 0 max = 9999 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_days_steel = pww_stk_dy }
}

pww_stock_value_steel = {
	pww_stock_tension_factor = yes
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stock_fill_steel }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 100 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stv_g }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 1 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stv_g min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = global.pww_stock_c_market }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_t }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_g }
}

pww_stock_seize_steel = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = pww_stock_steel }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = global.pww_stock_c_seize }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_steel = pww_stk_s }
	pww_stock_cap_steel = yes
	FROM = {
		add_to_variable = { pww_stock_steel = pww_stk_s }
		pww_stock_cap_steel = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stock_steel > pww_stock_cap_steel } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_steel = pww_stock_cap_steel }
			pww_stock_cap_steel = yes
		}
	}
}

### chromium

pww_stock_tick_chromium = {
	# Accrue the rates in force since the last tick.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_in_chromium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_out_chromium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	add_to_variable = { pww_stock_chromium = pww_stk_d }
	# Decay: global.pww_stock_c_decay of the stock per 30 days.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_chromium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = global.pww_stock_c_decay }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = 30 }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_chromium = pww_stk_d }
	clamp_variable = { var = pww_stock_chromium min = 0 max = 1000000 }

	# Stable balance B: what resource@ would read without our own flows.
	#   cost = the part of the intake applied as country_resource_cost (cartel
	#          withholding, or all of it when c_fill_cost = 1)
	#   leak = clamp(exported - (produced - out) x share, 0, out x share)
	#          (part of a draw re-exported under the trade law)
	#   B    = resource@ + cost - out + leak
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = resource_produced@chromium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = pww_stock_out_chromium }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_p }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_e }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = resource_exported@chromium }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_out_chromium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stk_e }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_lk > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_m } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_lk min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = resource@chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_cost_chromium }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_out_chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stk_lk }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_bal_chromium = pww_stk_b }

	pww_stock_cap_chromium = yes

	set_variable = { pww_stock_in_chromium = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_chromium = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_out_chromium = 0 }
	if = {
		# Fill: a share of the unsold leftover, within capacity and the daily
		# rate. By default (c_fill_cost = 0) it is stored WITHOUT a cost
		# modifier: the leftover is unused output, and a resource cost would
		# shrink the export pool (production x min_export), which the AI
		# buys out almost everywhere, so it would cut exports.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_chromium < pww_stock_cap_chromium }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = global.pww_stock_c_fill_share }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_chromium }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_chromium }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_chromium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_fill_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = global.pww_stock_c_fill_cost }
		# A cartel quota (pww_cartel_store_<res>, units a day) may ask storage
		# to take more: the extra is withheld through the cost modifier
		# (cutting exports is the quota's purpose), within B and capacity.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cartel_store_chromium > pww_stk_f } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_cartel_store_chromium }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_b } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_b } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_chromium }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_chromium }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_m } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_f } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_g }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_g }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_in_chromium = pww_stk_f }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_chromium = pww_stk_cst }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		# Draw: cover the shortfall, capped by throughput (a share of
		# capacity a day) and by what lasts until the next tick.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b < global.pww_stock_c_min_flow_neg }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_chromium > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_chromium }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_draw_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_chromium }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_out_chromium = pww_stk_f }
		}
	}
}

pww_stock_cap_chromium = {
	# Demand = met use + shortfall (resource_consumed is met use only: it
	# reads 0 for a country that has none of the resource).
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource_consumed@chromium }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { resource@chromium < 0 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource@chromium }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_use }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_sc < global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_base_days }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = pww_stock_depots }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = global.pww_stock_c_depot_mult }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_lv }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cap_chromium = pww_stk_sc }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = pww_stock_chromium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl value = pww_stock_cap_chromium if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_fill_chromium = pww_stk_fl }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_use < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stock_chromium }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stk_use }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_dy min = 0 max = 9999 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_days_chromium = pww_stk_dy }
}

pww_stock_value_chromium = {
	pww_stock_tension_factor = yes
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stock_fill_chromium }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 100 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stv_g }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 1 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stv_g min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = global.pww_stock_c_market }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_t }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_g }
}

pww_stock_seize_chromium = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = pww_stock_chromium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = global.pww_stock_c_seize }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_chromium = pww_stk_s }
	pww_stock_cap_chromium = yes
	FROM = {
		add_to_variable = { pww_stock_chromium = pww_stk_s }
		pww_stock_cap_chromium = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stock_chromium > pww_stock_cap_chromium } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_chromium = pww_stock_cap_chromium }
			pww_stock_cap_chromium = yes
		}
	}
}

### coal

pww_stock_tick_coal = {
	# Accrue the rates in force since the last tick.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_in_coal }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_out_coal }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	add_to_variable = { pww_stock_coal = pww_stk_d }
	# Decay: global.pww_stock_c_decay of the stock per 30 days.
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stock_coal }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = global.pww_stock_c_decay }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = pww_stk_el }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_d = 30 }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_coal = pww_stk_d }
	clamp_variable = { var = pww_stock_coal min = 0 max = 1000000 }

	# Stable balance B: what resource@ would read without our own flows.
	#   cost = the part of the intake applied as country_resource_cost (cartel
	#          withholding, or all of it when c_fill_cost = 1)
	#   leak = clamp(exported - (produced - out) x share, 0, out x share)
	#          (part of a draw re-exported under the trade law)
	#   B    = resource@ + cost - out + leak
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = resource_produced@coal }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_p = pww_stock_out_coal }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_p }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_e }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = resource_exported@coal }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_out_coal }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stk_e }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_lk > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lk = pww_stk_m } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_lk min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = resource@coal }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_cost_coal }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stock_out_coal }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_b = pww_stk_lk }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_bal_coal = pww_stk_b }

	pww_stock_cap_coal = yes

	set_variable = { pww_stock_in_coal = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_coal = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_out_coal = 0 }
	if = {
		# Fill: a share of the unsold leftover, within capacity and the daily
		# rate. By default (c_fill_cost = 0) it is stored WITHOUT a cost
		# modifier: the leftover is unused output, and a resource cost would
		# shrink the export pool (production x min_export), which the AI
		# buys out almost everywhere, so it would cut exports.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_coal < pww_stock_cap_coal }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = global.pww_stock_c_fill_share }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_coal }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_coal }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_coal }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_fill_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = global.pww_stock_c_fill_cost }
		# A cartel quota (pww_cartel_store_<res>, units a day) may ask storage
		# to take more: the extra is withheld through the cost modifier
		# (cutting exports is the quota's purpose), within B and capacity.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_cartel_store_coal > pww_stk_f } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_cartel_store_coal }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_b } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_b } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_coal }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_coal }
			divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_g = pww_stk_m } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_g > pww_stk_f } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_g }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cst = pww_stk_f }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_g }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_in_coal = pww_stk_f }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_cost_coal = pww_stk_cst }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		# Draw: cover the shortfall, capped by throughput (a share of
		# capacity a day) and by what lasts until the next tick.
		limit = {
			check_variable = { pww_stk_b < global.pww_stock_c_min_flow_neg }
			check_variable = { pww_stock_coal > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_cap_coal }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_draw_rate }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = pww_stock_coal }
		divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_m = global.pww_stock_c_period }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > pww_stk_m } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_f = pww_stk_m } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_f > global.pww_stock_c_min_flow } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_out_coal = pww_stk_f }
		}
	}
}

pww_stock_cap_coal = {
	# Demand = met use + shortfall (resource_consumed is met use only: it
	# reads 0 for a country that has none of the resource).
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource_consumed@coal }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { resource@coal < 0 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = resource@coal }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_use }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_sc < global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_min_scale } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = global.pww_stock_c_base_days }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = pww_stock_depots }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = global.pww_stock_c_depot_mult }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_lv = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_sc = pww_stk_lv }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_cap_coal = pww_stk_sc }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = pww_stock_coal }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_fl = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl value = pww_stock_cap_coal if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_fl min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_fill_coal = pww_stk_fl }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_stk_use < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_use = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stock_coal }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stk_dy = pww_stk_use }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stk_dy min = 0 max = 9999 }
	set_variable = { pww_stock_days_coal = pww_stk_dy }
}

pww_stock_value_coal = {
	pww_stock_tension_factor = yes
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stock_fill_coal }
	divide_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 100 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = pww_stv_g }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stv_g = 1 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_stv_g min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = global.pww_stock_c_market }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_t }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stock_unit_value = pww_stv_g }
}

pww_stock_seize_coal = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = pww_stock_coal }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_stk_s = global.pww_stock_c_seize }
	subtract_from_variable = { pww_stock_coal = pww_stk_s }
	pww_stock_cap_coal = yes
	FROM = {
		add_to_variable = { pww_stock_coal = pww_stk_s }
		pww_stock_cap_coal = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_stock_coal > pww_stock_cap_coal } }
			set_variable = { pww_stock_coal = pww_stock_cap_coal }
			pww_stock_cap_coal = yes
		}
	}
}

# All six resources (called by pww_stock_core.txt).
pww_stock_tick_all = {
	pww_stock_tick_aluminium = yes
	pww_stock_tick_rubber = yes
	pww_stock_tick_tungsten = yes
	pww_stock_tick_steel = yes
	pww_stock_tick_chromium = yes
	pww_stock_tick_coal = yes
}

pww_stock_cap_all = {
	pww_stock_cap_aluminium = yes
	pww_stock_cap_rubber = yes
	pww_stock_cap_tungsten = yes
	pww_stock_cap_steel = yes
	pww_stock_cap_chromium = yes
	pww_stock_cap_coal = yes
}

pww_stock_seize_all = {
	pww_stock_seize_aluminium = yes
	pww_stock_seize_rubber = yes
	pww_stock_seize_tungsten = yes
	pww_stock_seize_steel = yes
	pww_stock_seize_chromium = yes
	pww_stock_seize_coal = yes
}

# Country scope. Temp out pww_stk_prod (sum produced), pww_stk_cons (sum
# consumed), pww_stk_imp (sum imported) over the six stored resources.
pww_stock_sum_readings = {
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_prod = resource_produced@aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cons = resource_consumed@aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_imp = resource_imported@aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_prod = resource_produced@rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cons = resource_consumed@rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_imp = resource_imported@rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_prod = resource_produced@tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cons = resource_consumed@tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_imp = resource_imported@tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_prod = resource_produced@steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cons = resource_consumed@steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_imp = resource_imported@steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_prod = resource_produced@chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cons = resource_consumed@chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_imp = resource_imported@chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_prod = resource_produced@coal }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_cons = resource_consumed@coal }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_stk_imp = resource_imported@coal }
}
